name: marketing-presentations
description: Build HTML presentations, decks, report pages, and story pages that feel like high-end marketing/landing pages — scroll-driven visual storytelling with award-site craft (oversized typography, choreographed motion, section-by-section narrative), written first as a visual script and then implemented as a single-file HTML page. Ships the marketing-presentations skill: build (content → visual script → page, self-scored against 8 dimensions) and extract <url> (grow the knowledge base from a reference site). The bundled principles, style axes, and implementation patterns were validated in a design-extraction lab: three award-site extract → blind-clone → evaluate cycles, each passing at 8.3–8.6/10 — plus Part IV, what a brand-constrained marketing page needs beyond craft (an object, a stage, a boot state), validated by juring three takes on one product world.
